8. a) Joseph F. Sanek 
c) Mitchell Field Airport Director
d) 32
d) Stated that the construction of the Airport Spur would be in the public interest and be consistent with transportation planning. He felt the entire metropolitan area would benefit and any problems could be satisfactorily resolved.
f) ---
g) No response necessary.
9. a) Keith Graham 
c) Assistant Director of Southeastern Wisconsin Regional Planning Commission
d) 33
e) Spokesman for SEWRPC read a prepared statement indicating the Airport Spur is sound, in the public interest, and in accord with the long-range land use and transportation system development plans prepared by SEWRPC and urged for it's construction.
f) ---
g) Portion of Mr. Graham's testimony were incorporated into this Final EIS because of pertinent and informative nature. Refer to SEWRPC's Statement M-2 on page 194.
10. a) Marvin Rusch 
c) American Automobile Association
d) 42
e) Spokesman for AAA agreed with SEWRPC findings and was hopeful that the Airport Spur would be constructed as soon as possible in order to save tax dollars and bring safety to the streets and highways of the south side of Milwaukee.
f) ---
g) No response necessary
